name: Professional Services — Portfolio / Freelancer
definition: Personal work showcase, hire-me pages, case studies

business_name.label: Your name
business_name.followUp: What name should appear on your portfolio? For example, "Alex" or "Sam Rivera".

services.label: Specialties & services
services.followUp: What do you offer clients? Pick from the list or name your own specialties.

tagline.label: Portfolio tagline
tagline.followUp: What's a one-line tagline or headline? For example, "3D artist crafting immersive worlds" or "Brand designer for startups".

cta_preference.label: Hire-me CTA
cta_preference.followUp: How should potential clients reach you? Reply with contact form, email link, WhatsApp, or phone call.

city.label: Based in
city.followUp: What city are you based in? (Optional — reply skip to leave blank)

tone_preference.label: Portfolio vibe
tone_preference.followUp: What visual vibe fits your work? Reply with minimal, bold, warm, technical, or editorial.

email.label: Email address
email.followUp: What email should potential clients use to reach you?

linkedin_id.label: LinkedIn profile
linkedin_id.followUp: What's your LinkedIn profile ID or username? (optional — reply skip to leave blank)

x_account.label: X account
x_account.followUp: What's your X (Twitter) handle? (optional — reply skip to leave blank)
